why_it_matters: Integrity of the residual ledger: after 0120 the record said the endpoint residual at tPT2 was 'entirely data/record content, no analytic face left'. That was wrong in a way the machine just proved: the G-hs3 closure (T4OffD/T4OffM, right canonical point sigma = 1/2 + d0) covers only sigma >= 1/2, and T4OffL shows the left-flank S3 content is GENUINELY analytic - not a matter of missing data or a missing citation. The barriers are exact formal statements about the machine wire (exact rational pins throughout, zero numeric exp evaluation): at the band edge the wire's own first T4 term beats the floor by a margin that starts at ~0.6% at t = 10^10 and reaches ~13% at the frontier; at sigma = 0 no schedule at all can ever close. Consequence for the program: the endpoint residual at tPT2 is again FOUR named faces - (i) P1-P4 pin family (data), (ii) window zero-exclusion (record), (iii) machined hs3 at the right-flank witness (cited 1.6 convexity mass), (iv) G-hs3-left (ANALYTIC - a left-tuned tail/schedule theory for n^{-sigma} with sigma < 1/2, or a different wall entirely). This is the honest shape after 21 discoveries: the machine has eaten everything it can reach at the right flank; the left flank is where the real mathematics remains, and it is now named, bounded, and characterized (which schedules work per point, which cannot exist uniformly) - all in the tree, no RH claim.
next: Three candidates, in order of leverage: (1) Squeeze the G-hs3-left face at the DATA heights - below/around the verified frontier the off-pairs are measured, so the left-flank barrier can be checked per measured zero (does the actual tail at a left-flank witness zero exceed the actual floor?) turning part of the analytic face into measured data; (2) characterize the left-tuned schedule family formally - for fixed d0 < 1/2, n ~ t^{4/(1-2*d0)-eps} closes the term1-vs-floor inequality (the barrier's contrapositive as a construction): making the squeeze-impossibility a squeeze-POSSIBILITY with an explicit schedule, at the cost of a d0-dependent wire (breaking the n4 uniformity the rest of the tree is built on); (3) record the G-hs3-left face in RHEnd as a named premise of a strengthened endpoint (rh_program78_stripfront_mach_left), mirroring how part B8 restated hs1 - keeping the endpoint statement's face list in lockstep with the machine.
